reuse.why: Puts the new guard in the existing accounts/link.ts module next to findOrCreateBank, which every link handler already imports.

duplication.why: The query and error are defined once; each handler only adds a one-call guard.

placement.why: Link-time rules live in accounts/link.ts and the handlers in accounts/app.ts call it before any write, matching the existing layering.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, tested single definition; each new provider handler still has to remember to call it because the handlers have no shared link flow.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the five call sites are one-line calls to the shared guard.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/link.ts, called by the goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu and enableBanking link handlers in accounts/app.ts.
